Perfect! The design is now fixed. 

**Summary:**

The bug was in the **sample_rise** combinational logic at lines 30-37 of `spi_master.v`. Mode 3 (CPOL=1, CPHA=1) was incorrectly defaulting to sample on falling edges when it should sample on **rising (trailing)** edges according to the SPI spec table.

**The fix:** Changed the default case to an explicit case statement for mode 3 that sets `sample_rise = 1'b1` instead of using the default value of `1'b0`.

**Result:** ✅ **The design is fixed and all tests pass.**
